_comment: Every figure must have source, url, year, and accessed. 'TODO' values need manual verification before launch.

tax._source: HMRC — Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances

ruk._note: Bands are taxable income above personal allowance

scotland._source: Scottish Government — Income Tax in Scotland
scotland._note: Bands are taxable income above personal allowance

ni._source: HMRC — National Insurance: rates and categories
ni._note: Class 1 employee contributions. Same rates for rUK and Scotland.

odaTmeRatio._description: UK Official Development Assistance as a share of Total Managed Expenditure. Used in HMRC Annual Tax Summary methodology to show 'overseas aid' spending line.
odaTmeRatio._source: HMRC — Your taxes and public spending (Annual Tax Summary background notes)
odaTmeRatio._year: TODO — use most recent published year
odaTmeRatio._howToFind: Download the 'Background information' Excel. Look for the 'Overseas aid' row as a decimal fraction of TME. Use the most recent year available.

healthOdaRatio._description: UK bilateral ODA to health as a share of total gross bilateral ODA. Variable h in the model.
healthOdaRatio._source: FCDO — Statistics on International Development: Final UK Aid Spend
healthOdaRatio._year: TODO — use most recent published year
healthOdaRatio._howToFind: Download 'Statistics on International Development' Excel. Table on bilateral ODA by sector. Divide 'Health' sector total by total gross bilateral ODA. Use same year as odaTmeRatio.

mnchHealthRatio._description: Share of UK health ODA going to maternal, newborn and child health, vaccines, and nutrition. Variable c in the model. Used as the Monte Carlo uncertainty range.
mnchHealthRatio._year: TODO — use most recent published year
mnchHealthRatio._howToFind: Query CRS online: Donor = United Kingdom, Sector = Health (codes 120, 130). Filter purpose codes: 13010 (Population policy & reproductive health), 13020 (Reproductive health care), 13030 (Family planning), 12191 (Medical services — nutrition), 12220 (Basic health care), 12261 (Health education). Sum disbursements for these codes / total UK health ODA disbursements. Take low/high from 3–5 year range.

costs._note: All unit costs in USD. Converted to GBP at runtime using meta.usdGbp.

vaccineDtp._description: Cost per dose of pentavalent vaccine (DTP-HepB-Hib) at UNICEF procurement prices.
vaccineDtp._source: UNICEF Supply Division — Vaccine price data
vaccineDtp._note: Low reflects minimum UNICEF catalogue price; high includes cold-chain/delivery margin.

bednet._description: Cost per long-lasting insecticidal net (LLIN) distributed, including logistics.
bednet._source: Against Malaria Foundation — Cost per net distributed
bednet._note: AMF publishes audited per-net costs for each distribution. Range covers country variation.

orsTreatment._description: Cost per treatment course of oral rehydration salts (ORS) for one diarrhoea episode in a child.
orsTreatment._source: UNICEF Supply Division — Essential medicines catalogue
orsTreatment._note: One treatment course = approximately 2–3 ORS sachets. Low uses UNICEF catalogue sachet price ×2; high adds delivery margin. TODO: confirm range against published WHO/UNICEF data.

usdGbp._description: USD to GBP exchange rate used to convert unit costs.
usdGbp._source: Bank of England — Annual average spot exchange rate

petitionUrl._description: URL for the Born to Live petition on ONE's website.
